title: Shader baker on iOS results in Metal validation errors (and failed draw calls) when dynamically creating materials
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable, 4.8.dev [12c17c187e88efa23e6bbd6689630e256eca6523]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (12c17c187) - macOS Tahoe (26.6.2) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (2560x1440 @ 144.00 Hz) - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In short, if you make even the most barebones shader and then dynamically create a `ShaderMaterial` for it through scripts, and assign that to a `Control`, and then export that with an iOS debug template, you'll run into the following validation error at runtime when launching it from Xcode:

```
-[MTLDebugRenderCommandEncoder validateCommonDrawErrors:]:5970: failed assertion `Draw Errors Validation
Vertex Function(main0): argument canvas_data[0] from Buffer(0) with offset(0) and length(160) has space for 160 bytes, but argument has a length(272).
Fragment Function(main0): argument canvas_data[0] from Buffer(0) with offset(0) and length(160) has space for 160 bytes, but argument has a length(272).'
```

The device I'm able to repro this on is an iPhone 17 running iOS 26.0.1.

If you run the app outside of Xcode, you'll find that the shadered `TextureRect` does draw, but the `PanelContainer` with the `Label` in it does not, for some strange reason.

Assigning that same shader to a `ShaderMaterial` that's assigned normally through the property inspector in the relevant scene seemingly results in everything working just fine.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP on macOS.
2. Run it on macOS.
3. Note how there's a pink `TextureRect` (shaded by a shader) at the top and some text at the bottom.
4. Export the project to iOS, with shader baker enabled.
5. Run the app from Xcode.
6. Note the Metal validation error.
7. Run the app from the phone directly.
8. Note how the text at the bottom is gone.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ios-shader-baker-validation-error.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32956434/ios-shader-baker-validation-error.zip)
